_comment: THE one source of truth for the edge. The Caddyfile is RENDERED from this (tools/edge/render.py) and is never hand-edited: the cert, the routing host and the URLs a client calls must not be able to drift apart. Every value here is validated before it is interpolated — see tools/edge/validate.py and phase-32 T1.
_routes: Longest prefix wins — the renderer sorts, so listing order cannot create a shadowing bug. strip_prefix uses Caddy's handle_path (the prefix is removed before forwarding).
_fallback: The SPA. Remove this block and the edge answers 404 for anything unrouted, explicitly, rather than letting Caddy choose.
